entities.name: Annie Holmström
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Annie Sofia Holmström was a Swedish tennis player. She competed in singles and mixed doubles at the 1912 Summer Olympics and finished in fourth-fifth place. Her elder sister Ellen Brusewitz competed in singles at the same Olympics.
